prompt.project_info: Photorealistic smartphone-style bathroom portrait with a red Spider-Man-inspired suit and everyday domestic setting.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with fair skin, long straight dark-brown hair, symmetrical features, green-hazel eyes, defined brows and natural skin variation, wearing a red sleeveless halter-neck bodysuit with black web pattern, blue trim and supplied spider emblem.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered vertical medium shot from thighs up, eye-level slightly frontal. She stands upright with weight shifted naturally, one hand resting on a speckled granite countertop, the other relaxed by her side, head slightly tilted and direct neutral gaze. Preserve the red-blue suit and emblem without body-volume emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse indoor artificial light from overhead/front creates even facial illumination and gentle natural shadows on the suit and bathroom surfaces.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone photography, 50–85mm portrait lens, moderate depth of field, vertical composition, realistic skin and fabric texture, natural color grading.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic smartphone-style bathroom portrait of one original approved adult woman with fair skin, long straight dark-brown hair, symmetrical features, green-hazel eyes, defined brows and natural skin variation. She wears a red sleeveless halter-neck Spider-Man-inspired bodysuit with black web pattern, blue trim and a supplied spider emblem. Use a centered vertical medium shot from thighs up at eye level and slightly frontal. She stands upright with weight shifted naturally, one hand resting on a speckled granite countertop, the other relaxed by her side, head slightly tilted and a direct neutral gaze. Include a wooden door with a tall frosted-glass panel, towel bar and neutral cream walls. Use soft diffuse indoor artificial light from overhead and slightly frontal, moderate depth of field, 50–85mm portrait perspective, realistic skin and fabric texture and natural color grading.
